title: A.R.M.O.R. event of the vision service, as it reports it to the server
description: The body of POST /api/v1/ai/vision-events: one object that entered a zone, as ARMOR-VISION sees it. `schema` is `armor.vision.event/v1`, or `armor.vision.event/v2` when the event also says how many radar targets were being followed (`radar_tracks`). `type` is the kind of the zone: `alert` (the server raises an alarm while the system is armed) or `detection` (only recorded). `box` is `[x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]` in fractions of the picture. `vectors`, when given, say where the objects of the camera were heading at that moment: one per followed object (at most 16), `dx` and `dy` the unit direction in the picture (y grows downwards) and `speed` in pictures per second. It carries no picture and `authorizes_action` is always false: it reports what was seen and never asks for anything to be done.
